findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 指出 TAC 率持續受裝置組合、夥伴組合、經由付費入口的查詢比例、各通路廣告營收相對成長率等變動影響，並提及營收從 Google Network 轉向 Google Search & other。
findings.excerpt: shift from Google Network properties to Google Search & other properties. Our TAC rate will continue to be affected by changes in device mix; geographic mix; partner agreement terms; partner mix; the percentage of queries channeled through paid access points; product mix; the relative revenue growth rates of advertising revenues from different channels; and revenue share terms.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 競爭段落：廣告競爭取決於吸引用戶（其他產品『僅一鍵之遙』）、廣告主與內容提供者，並須跨多種分銷通路投放，即使廣告媒介與用戶偏好趨勢改變。
findings.excerpt: advertisers, primarily based on our ability to generate sales leads, and ultimately customers, and to deliver their advertisements in an efficient and effective manner across a variety of distribution channels even as trends in advertising mediums and user preferences change

findings.claim: Q1 2026 Alphabet 付費訂閱數增加 2,500 萬至 3.5 億，subscriptions, platforms and devices 營收 +19% 至 124 億美元；CEO 稱用戶轉訂閱方案對廣告營收有負面影響。
findings.excerpt: The company’s total number of paid subscriptions reached 350 million, with YouTube and Google One identified as the largest contributors.

findings.claim: Apple Safari 搜尋量下滑證詞與 AI 瀏覽器（Atlas 等）被視為對 Google 預設通路的威脅；Google 公開否認 Safari 搜尋量下降。
findings.source: SAN: Apple, Google $20 billion search deal at risk amid rise of AI
